operation: Read actual MyFightDamage flags and root CustomDamageUITypeFilter fields from the pinned official native prefabs with strict managed schemas. No filter is inferred from combat stats or character type.
legacy_records: Absent DamageEntityId remains zero and uses original MyFightDamage defaults (hide=false, showZero=true). Do not confuse the runtime damage serial or hit entity identity with the missing damage prefab identity. Positive unbound prefab IDs fail explicitly.
